title: Rethinking Representation Geometry in Supervised Contrastive Learning under Long-Tailed Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.32039v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Supervised contrastive learning and its balanced variants have demonstrated their effectiveness for representation learning under long-tailed distributions. However, although prior analyses suggest that their optimal representations may exhibit a regular simplex geometry, whether such a geometry is indeed exhibited remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we present a theoretical framework for these objectives that characterizes whether a regular simplex is formed at the optimum. By applying this to representative objectives, we show that these objectives fail to form a regular simplex at the optimum because they remain dependent on the number of samples per class. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce structural balancing that can be applied to contrastive objectives, and propose a fully balanced contrastive objective that provably forms a regular simplex geometry at its optimum. translated_title: 重新思考长尾数据下监督对比学习中的表示几何
translated_abstract: 监督对比学习及其平衡变体已在长尾分布下的表示学习中展现了其有效性。然而，尽管先前的分析表明其最优表示可能呈现正则单纯形几何结构，但这种几何结构是否确实存在仍然缺乏充分的理解。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个理论框架，用于刻画这些目标函数在最优解处是否形成正则单纯形。通过将该框架应用于代表性的目标函数，我们表明这些目标函数在最优解处无法形成正则单纯形，因为它们仍然依赖于每个类别的样本数量。受这一分析的启发，我们引入了可应用于对比目标的结构平衡方法，并提出了一种完全平衡的对比目标，该目标可证明地在其最优解处形成正则单纯形几何结构。理论和实证结果均表……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了现有长尾数据下的监督对比学习目标因依赖每类样本数量而无法在最优解处形成正则单纯形几何，并提出结构平衡方法与完全平衡的对比目标，可证明地实现正则单纯形几何。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that existing supervised contrastive objectives under long-tailed data fail to form a regular simplex geometry at the optimum due to their dependence on per-class sample counts, and proposes structural balancing with a fully balanced contrastive objective that provably achieves a regular simplex geometry at its optimum.
